title: Independent dev-log checkpoint files
summary: Checkpoint recording now writes each entry independently, reducing merge contention when game work and release logging advance in parallel.
details: Seven new dev-log tests pass, including 24 simultaneous writes, a standard Git merge of two branches with independent status updates, exact-commit reads that ignore dirty files, private screenshot snapshots, release text-only packaging, and live HTTP GET/HEAD aggregation.
All 35 release tests pass with one opt-in skip, and make verify passes.
Builds, the dev-log server, R2 publication, and snapshots aggregate independent entries automatically. AGENTS.md directs routine logging away from shared HANDOFF.md and DEPLOYMENT.md edits.

Final host verification passed: make check covered 422 Rust tests across crates, the JavaScript suite, strict Clippy and formatting, Python syntax, eight build-cache tests, and seven dev-log tests; make web passed.

Live desktop and 390px mobile dev-log checks passed across all 196 checkpoints and 30 feature areas, including filters, zero console/page errors, and 390px scrollWidth. Browser review found long hashes and paths could overflow; .entry-copy now wraps anywhere.
limitation: Tooling-only checkpoint with no gameplay change. CI and public deployment are pending at recording time. Older branches should update from main before using the new recorder.
